name: situation-record
title: Draft situation record
for_each: select id,code from programs order by code

sections.title: Programme
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,kind,status from programs where id=$1

sections.title: Requests
sections.note: Planning and coordination records only. No dispatch performed.
sections.sql: select code,name,item,unit,quantity,status,owner,due from requests where program_id=$1 order by due,code

sections.title: Exercise follow-up
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due,status,evidence from actions where program_id=$1 order by due,code

name: receipt-record
title: Resource receipt record
for_each: select id,code from allocations where status='received' order by code

sections.title: Receipt
sections.sql: select a.code,q.code as request,r.code as resource,a.quantity,r.unit,a.receipt_ref,a.received_by,a.received_at from allocations a join requests q on q.id=a.request_id join resources r on r.id=a.resource_id where a.id=$1

name: plan-review
title: Emergency plan evidence checklist
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Gaps for review
sections.note: NZ regulation 14 / Australian model regulation 43 evidence prompts. A qualified reviewer checks the plan and local duties.
sections.sql: select gaps,next_test from readiness where id=$1
